text.text_excerpt: Came in after a loooong hiatus due to the smoking ban. Man, this is an excellent bar. And, not to far from my house! I stopped in to meet some friends watching Johnny Angel and the Pettit Brothers for a night of Country/Western. It is so wonderful to have live music so close to home...in a clean (smoke-free) bar, with good service and affordable drinks. Live music is played every night at DMac's and they're opened 24/7. The bar caters to an older crowd, a more relaxed vibe. It felt like a saloon, right out of Texas. I'm sure it feels like a blues dive on blues night and a rock-n-roll bar when the band has an electric guitar! It's pretty obvious that this place caters to the musicians and ...

I've been to this spot a few times now. Being a Mid City resident of the past 4 1/2 years, I had no idea there was a 24 hour watering hole right within walking distance from my house. I'm typically 'good' at a 'decent' hour when visiting my other bars, but it's comforting knowing there's always a door open ready to pollute my body at any time of the day or night should I need it. The crowd is definitely more mature than your Finn's or Twelve Mile, i've seen the bikers in the building, but I dig kicking it and having some drinks with that crowd, those people are hella chill and mad cool (like how I went east/west coast with that?) Drinks are reasonably priced, but the burgers...OH the burg...

I have been wanting to go here forever since i live right down the road. only locals go here which is cool. live music is always a plus. i got a burger and was very pleased. it was pretty cheap too. fries werent bad. i would probably get something else next time but just because i am curious. i could easily stick with the burger. word on the street is they serve food 24/7 so that is amazing. def see myself here late night in the future. it will be interesting to see the clientele as the night goes on too. cool place
